system.description:
• Undead Resilience: At the start of each encounter, gain temporary HP equal to the total HD of all undead under your control, up to your Necromancer level.
  • Example: zombie (2 HD) + skeleton (1 HD) + wight (4 HD) = 7 temporary HP
  • Temporary HP last until the end of the encounter

activities.name: Undead Resilience
activities.text: At the start of each encounter: temporary HP equal to the total HD of all undead you control, up to the number below (your Necromancer level). They last until the encounter ends; add them with the Temp HP button.
